name: Functional - Error Handling in process_message
description: Checks that process_message returns a user-friendly error message when an exception occurs during LLM call.
input: A user message that triggers an exception in the LLM client (e.g., by mocking the client to raise an exception).
output: A string apologizing for the error is returned.
success_criteria: response contains 'I apologize, but I encountered an error processing your request'
error_scenarios: No error message is returned to the user
